board.subtitle: Pick a mission type: the server draws a random mission of that type for you.
board.subtitle_operation: A Cross-Department Mission is active: it is the only mission that can be started.
board.blocked.not_leader: Only your unit leader can pick a mission type.
board.unit.solo: You pick the mission type. Build a unit on the Unit screen to take a mission on together.
board.unit.leader: You lead: every member gets the same mission, and invites close when you accept.
board.unit.member: Only your unit leader picks the type; every member gets the same mission.
board.card.tod_hint: Type of the Day: double points today (cash is not doubled)
board.card.on_call_text: missions unlock when your real call clears
board.card.busy_text: the run cap is reached, try again shortly
board.card.ready: Ready · drawn at random when you accept
board.boss.text: One attempt per officer per week. Abandoning it uses up that attempt.
board.boss.unavailable: Not available for you right now
board.op.fact_any_dept: Up to {max} officers from any department
board.op.fact_lock: Every other mission is locked until it ends
board.op.joined_wait: You joined. Your start route is set when the launcher starts it.
board.op.joined_waiting: The last attempt ended. A supervisor can relaunch or cancel it.
board.op.closed_running: Joining is closed: the mission has started.
board.op.closed_waiting: Joining is closed until a supervisor relaunches it.
board.op.on_run: Finish your current mission before joining.
board.op.can_join: Officers from every department can join.
board.op.cannot_join: You can't join right now (for example while you respond to a real call).
board.notice.on_run_text: Finish or abandon it before accepting another mission type.
board.notice.op_text: Every department's board shows only this mission until it is completed or cancelled.
board.notice.on_call_text: You're responding to a real call. Missions unlock when the call clears.
board.notice.busy_text: The server-wide run cap is reached. Cards unlock as other runs finish.
board.empty.title: No mission types available
board.empty.text: No mission type can be shown right now. Try again in a moment.
board.footnote: Missions are drawn at random from the chosen type's pool. There is no reroll.
board.confirm.title: Accept a {type} mission?
board.confirm.random: A random {type} mission is drawn for you and revealed only after you accept. There is no reroll.
board.confirm.abandon: The mission is drawn at random; abandoning it, leaving the start route or not reaching the start in time puts the whole {type} type on cooldown.
board.confirm.boss_random: You get one attempt at {mission} this week.
board.confirm.boss_abandon: Abandoning it, leaving the start route or not reaching the start in time uses up this week's attempt.
board.confirm.unit: Every member of your unit of {size} gets the same mission, and unit invites close.
board.confirm.route: A GPS route to the start is set when you accept: follow it.
run.subtitle_accepted: Follow the route to the start. The run moves to In progress when the first participant arrives.
run.subtitle_in_progress: Complete the objectives before the timer runs out.
run.test_note: Nothing is saved or paid, and no cooldown starts.
run.hero.modifier_hint: Modifier: extra points and cash for this run
run.hero.timer_waiting: Starts when the first participant arrives
run.route.title: Route to the start
run.route.on_text: Follow the GPS route to the mission start.
run.route.arrived_text: The route check has stopped for you.
run.route.disabled_test: Test run: the start route check is off. Drive to the start to begin.
run.route.disabled_text: No start route is tracked for this run.
run.route.rules: The route shown is the only accepted way to the start. Staying off it ends your run as Abandoned and puts the type on cooldown.
run.recalc.title: Recalculate the route?
run.recalc.text: A new route to the start is drawn from where you are now. Recalculations left: {n}.
run.partners.title: Partners
run.silence.title: Radio Silence
run.silence.text: No blips for mission NPCs or objectives after the start, and this screen names streets and zones only. The start route still shows.
run.log.title: Log the result
run.log.text: Log what you found at this point. A correct log earns points, a wrong one costs points.
run.abandon.title: Abandon {mission}?
run.abandon.text: You get no points and no cash for this run.
run.abandon.cooldown: The whole {type} mission type goes on cooldown.
run.abandon.boss: This uses up your Weekly Boss attempt for this week.
run.abandon.test: Test run: nothing is saved and no cooldown starts.
run.abandon.team: The run continues for your partners and rescales for the team that's left.
run.empty.title: No active mission
run.empty.text: Pick a type on the Mission Board. The mission is drawn at random and shows here once you accept.
run.hero.start_hint: Otherwise the run ends as Abandoned
